parts.name: D1 max over arms and cases of abs(u(new) + u(old) - 1), change@0 and change@1
D3 p(det fires on the patch | memory)
D3 p(det fires on the patch | correlated)
D3 p(det fires at all | none)
D5 sheet cost under scattered cue damage: r_all(rest) - r_all(det), cue@0
D5 sheet cost with no event: r_all(rest) - r_all(det), none@0
D6 p(fires on the patch | correlated): det - det-v
D8 sheet cost under misread cues with no event: r_all(rest) - r_all(det), none@1

statements.claim: on the information-limit pair the tissue's detector cannot win: its controller ties like every arm
statements.rule: HOLDS if, in change@0 and change@1, the largest abs(u(arm, change/new) + u(arm, change/old) - 1) over every arm (the detectors' included) and case is at most 1e-12, else FAILS (derived identity)

statements.claim: the controller driven by the tissue's own detector is not worse than the best fixed policy by more than 0.03 (non-inferiority; whether it beats the vote is the development's 95% interval, reported, and the confirmation's test)
statements.rule: HOLDS if U(det) - U(BEST) >= -0.03, else FAILS

statements.claim: the detector finds memory and correlated damage on the patch and stays quiet with no event
statements.rule: HOLDS if det fires with its footprint on the patch in at least 0.7 of memory-damage lineage-cases and 0.7 of correlated-damage ones, and fires at all in at most 0.5 of no-event ones, else FAILS

statements.claim: making the signal costs little: the declared signal's exact value at det's own firing predicts U(det) from below
statements.rule: HOLDS if U(det) - U_pred(det) >= -0.005, else FAILS (U_pred: per lineage-case and scoring, fire x u(dial) + (1 - fire) x u(rest))

statements.claim: the tissue's false alarms cost the sheet within AR001C's harm bound
statements.rule: HOLDS if r_all(rest) - r_all(det) is at most 0.01 under scattered cue damage (cue@0) and at most 0.002 with no event (none@0), else FAILS

statements.claim: a detector built from the copies mostly misses an error they share; the independent cue's sees it and is worth more
statements.rule: HOLDS if, in correlated damage, det's rate of firing with its footprint on the patch exceeds det-v's by at least 0.4, and U(det) - U(det-v) >= 0.02, else FAILS

statements.claim: the tissue's signal keeps at least half of the declared signal's worth at AR001C's confirmed point, and reaches the ceiling of a signal sent promptly over the patch
statements.rule: HOLDS if (U(det) - U(rest)) - (U_ctrl(0.9, 0.1) - U(rest)) / 2 >= 0.0 and U(det) - U_ceiling >= -0.005, else FAILS

statements.claim: misread cues cost the detector: false alarms with no event, and lost hits in memory damage
statements.rule: HOLDS if, under GC001's misread (sigma 1) against the exact cue, r_all(rest) - r_all(det) with no event is at most 0.005, and u(det, memory) misread - exact <= -0.1, else FAILS
